entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: GRAYSCALE HEIGHT FIELD for a matching game normal map. Input image is the exact diffuse target. Preserve EVERY seam, ridge, bark fissure and plate boundary at the same normalized position and scale. Convert only actual geometry to shallow height: smooth uniform material planes neutral gray, recesses darker, raised lips modestly brighter. Remove color and lighting entirely.  Ignore metal patina, lichen color, specular highlights and any amber inlay COLOR when deciding height. No new shapes, no text, no presentation frame, no perspective, no directional illumination or sculpt render. Single full-bleed grayscale texture with the same aspect ratio as input. Continuous edge-compatible relief for tiling; only the height data image.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: grayscale geometric HEIGHT MAP authoring master, to be differentiated into a subtle tangent-space normal map. Image 1 is the UV-locked diffuse atlas of a Fury-infected CCA building. Keep the image crop, every island, boundary, vent, vine and panel at EXACTLY the same normalized pixel positions; DO NOT redesign, move, enlarge or invent features. Replace colour and baked lighting with a GRAYSCALE HEIGHT field: flat painted metal plates are uniform middle gray; recessed joints and vent openings dark gray; raised rim lips and grown biometal vines gently brighter; all painted stripes, stars, numbers, colored lamps and scratches have NO height merely because they are bright. Treat blue light interiors as inset sockets rather than white raised bumps. Smooth physically coherent shallow shapes with no directional illumination, no highlights, no photographic shadows or perspective. Black unused atlas areas stay black. Eliminate all hue. Only a single full-bleed square grayscale map, no labels, legends, comparison layout, text, frame or RGB normal-map colours. It must register with the input atlas when resized to 1024x1024; keep EVERY feature's exact size and placement.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: grayscale shallow HEIGHT MAP for the original Olympian relic UV atlas. Image 1 is the edit target. Keep every UV island, silhouette, seam, slit, rib and damaged edge in EXACTLY the same position and proportion. No redesign at all. Remove ALL color, mottled paint, patina and lighting, converting only existing actual surface geometry into a neutral-gray height field: uniform flat plate faces mid gray, narrow recessed seams darker, existing raised ribs slightly lighter, slots dark, damaged cut layers softly stepped. The big glossy circular lens (if present) must be a smooth uniform gray field with NO painted specular highlight. Amber light regions (if present) are smooth recessed insets, NOT white raised strips. No new detail or objects. Smooth shallow physically coherent heights only, no clay-render directional shadows, no lighting gradient, no perspective, no labels or layout. Black unused atlas regions stay black. Single full-bleed square grayscale map registered exactly to the original texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: emissive game display texture for ancient Olympian relic interiors in Battlezone Campaign Reimagined. Three equal square display cells side by side in one 3:1 landscape image, filling the image edge to edge, no surrounding monitor casing. Each cell has the same narrow inset rounded angular ancient bronze line frame on near-black green charcoal glass. Delicate restrained amber and muted gray-green luminous linework: left cell abstract cargo/biometal inventory nodes, center cell vertical interlocking process indicators, right cell sparse navigation constellation/route plot. Nonhuman curved geometric notation, NOT readable letters, numbers or English text. Tiny precise illuminated markings with lots of dark negative space, no intense bloom, no reflections, no cast shadows, no eye, no skull, no pictorial scene, no rendered room, no labels, no watermark, no modern human UI. Straight-on orthographic flat texture data. Consistent dark bronze/amber ancient-machine identity, subtle rather than neon. Cells must occupy exactly the left, middle and right thirds. Texture only.
